coach.ex: She coaches the girls' soccer team.
coach.pt: Ela treina o time de futebol feminino.

tournament.ex: Our tournament starts on Saturday morning.
tournament.pt: Nosso torneio começa no sábado de manhã.

rainy.ex: The game was canceled on a rainy day.
rainy.pt: O jogo foi cancelado em um dia chuvoso.

tennis court.pt: A quadra de tênis está molhada.

team captain.ex: The team captain gave a short speech.

sports bag.ex: I left my sports bag in the car.
